roles.title: Technical Product Manager, Identification & JS Agent

bullets: Own delivery coordination for specific product features, epics, or workstreams within priorities and constraints set by the Sr TPM.
Translate Sr TPM intent into clear user stories, jobs-to-be-done, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done.
Maintain Jira epics, tasks, acceptance criteria, and delivery status in partnership with Engineering.
Keep systems of record accurate and current, including Notion, Jira, Productboard, and relevant roadmap or release tracking tools.
Support backlog refinement, sprint-ready sequencing, and release readiness activities.
